name: Bound Immortal
summary: It comes back from nothing whenever an Object is waiting for it in the Retire Zone.

face.name: Bound Immortal

boundReturn.text: If this Entity had no Objects assigned, you may put it back onto your Front by assigning it an Object with Flux cost 2 or less from your Retire Zone, without paying its cost. If there is no such Object in your Retire Zone, it doesn't come back.

face.flavor: It doesn't die: it waits for the weapon that calls it back.
